name: Voter Action Project Voter Registration Team
subject: Must increase registration nationwide
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
We refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. That means refocusing our anger and our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .
Massive voter participation is more crucial now than ever. RUSH $30 or more today and help us register a tidal wave of new voters nationwide >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=081826_4&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Supreme Court ruled in favor of voter suppression and against underrepresented communities in Louisiana v. Callais , folks.
This is a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve . If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote .
How? Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, chip in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=081826_4&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=081826_4&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=081826_4&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=081826_4&amount=50]

Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and move forward to a better future.
Our voter registration work -- at just about $3 per new voter -- is more necessary now than ever. Can you pitch in with $30 and give us the resources we need to register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=081826_4&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=081826_4&amount=20]

Wednesday’s deadline marks the LAST time we’ll report our fundraising to the FEC before the primary election. That means it’s our LAST chance to prove we can defeat the MAGA billionaires who are dumping money into this race to try to buy the Granite State’s Senate seat.
It’s no exaggeration to say this is the biggest test our campaign has faced so far. And our ability to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue and flip control of the Senate will come down to whether we can raise enough to build a winning campaign.
**We need to take this opportunity to show the size and strength of this grassroots team, so I’m humbly asking:**

This FEC deadline is our final opportunity before the primary for us to show that we have the support needed to win here in New Hampshire.
With your help our FEC report will prove that we have the support of everyday folks like you. Together we can prove that New Hampshire is not for sale.
_[**So, friend, what do you say? clean_body: | | | | Friend, I’m reaching out personally, because this Wednesday - on August 19th - our campaign will face our final FEC deadline before New Hampshire’s primary election. Look, friend, this deadline is different from our usual monthly and quarterly deadlines I’ve emailed you about before. And I want to tell you exactly why: Wednesday’s deadline marks the LAST time we’ll report our fundraising to the FEC before the primary election. That means it’s our LAST chance to prove we can defeat the MAGA billionaires who are dumping money into this race to try to buy the Granite State’s Senate seat. It’s no exaggeration to say this is the biggest test our campaign has faced so far. And our ability to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue and flip control of the Senate will come down to whether we can raise enough to build a winning campaign. We need to take this opportunity to show the size and strength of this grassroots team, so I’m humbly asking: Right now Republicans are outspending us at a ratio of 3 to 1. They’re counting on us to be intimidated by their spending; they believe that flooding the airwaves will discourage our campaign from moving forward. This FEC deadline is our final opportunity before the primary for us to show that we have the support needed to win here in New Hampshire. With your help our FEC report will prove that we have the support of everyday folks like you. Together we can prove that New Hampshire is not for sale. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | Thank you for all that you do, Chris Pappas The Nevada State Democratic Party fights for progress in the Silver State. # We Have 4 Hours To the Deadline - I Will Match Your Donation TONIGHT.
Dear Friend, We have four hours left until the first fundraising deadline is over. Don't let this pass without [standing with us](https://us.list-manage.com/13eZjjQvyOj?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b), please.

We have a professional vendor standing by with the ability to reach 400,000 swing voters for us. We just need to raise the additional funds to cover this amazing initiative.

**And tonight I will match your donation**. Once again, I am putting our skin in the game again to show you how much we care for our State and to ask that you also step up and help us now.

| | Peter,
**It’s official. The ballots are counted, and I made it through the 12-way “jungle primary” to the general election for Washington’s 5th Congressional District.**
This was the largest primary field since the founding of our district. You chose me. I don’t take that lightly.
Before anything else, I want you to sit with one number: **47%.**
That’s how much of the vote incumbent Michael Baumgartner got. The only Republican in the race. With every advantage of the office, a massive fundraising edge he never had to work for, and not a single Republican splitting his vote.
**More than 52% of Eastern Washington voted for someone other than their own congressman. That is not a safe seat for the incumbent. That is a district looking for a change.**
**We have said from the beginning that Eastern Washington deserves more problem-solving, less politics. That the House representative should answer to the people of this district, not to party elites. On August 4th, a majority of Eastern Washington voters agreed.**
Now we have 60 days until ballots drop for the general election.
We’ll talk soon about exactly where this campaign stands and what it’s going to take. But for today: thank you. To the volunteers who knocked doors in 100-degree heat. To the donors who gave $5 when $5 wasn’t easy to give. To everyone who put a sign in their yard or window, showing neighbors their support when the field looked too crowded to clear. subject: It feels like nobody is running for governor
body:
Plus: Card delinquencies are back at Great Recession levels. | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/13FFHPnIvmB?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | It feels like nobody is running for governor right now.
Mark's hearing that [Deb Haaland's people think they're up double digits](https://us.list-manage.com/RXDekGkNpwT?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e), and from what we can tell they're acting like it. In other news, credit card delinquencies are also back where they were during the Great Recession, which matters because every midterm comes down to the economy.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/XgS5ANBzPBC?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🏛️ **HAALAND'S CAMP THINKS THEY'RE UP DOUBLE DIGITS**
Mark has been saying for weeks that a quiet race is bad news, and this one has been very quiet.
He goes through what he's hearing about the mood inside her operation, the poll she sent out to thousands of donors, and why that poll probably raised her more money than it cost her.
Gregg Hull has Sandoval County. He's running out of time to introduce himself to the other 32, and nothing about this race gets louder on its own.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/Xh4cAIDgEyE?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 💰 **CREDIT CARD DELINQUENCIES ARE BACK AT GREAT RECESSION LEVELS**
The New York Fed's numbers landed Tuesday, and they're bad enough that both parties are already building 2026 campaigns around them.
Scott Jennings went on CNN with his version of how Republicans should handle it. Mark agrees with roughly half of that, and the half he doesn't is the part worth hearing.
Krysty takes it somewhere else. Her mother never carried a balance in her life, and Krysty's argument about why has almost nothing to do with Washington and everything to do with what you're holding in your hand when you pay.

📰 **THE JOURNAL HANDED THE SNAP STORY TO AN INTERN**
The tagline at the bottom says the writer is an intern with a statewide fellowship program, which is fine, except the Journal ran the piece with Stansbury and two food bank employees as the only voices in it.
Mark spent about three minutes looking and came up with six things missing from that article, including why people actually came off the rolls and a nine-figure bill that New Mexico taxpayers could end up covering. He's not blaming the intern, and he's pretty clear about who he thinks should have caught it.
🎓 **IT ISN'T THE PROFESSORS. WSJ EXPLAINS WHERE CAMPUS SOCIALISM STARTS**
Lazy rivers, buses with no fare, a dining hall where nothing has a price on it. Four years of that, then a $200,000 bill and a job market that works nothing like it.
Krysty read a good chunk of the Wall Street Journal piece out loud on the show, and there's a comparison in there about the dining hall, one kid with three plates of pasta and another with a salad, that lands a lot harder than it sounds like it should.

clean_body: This is Senator Maggie Hassan. I need just 60 seconds to talk to you about Chris Pappas and the New Hampshire Senate race. I know what it’s like to run a competitive NH Senate race -- I won in 2016 by just 1,017 votes. Chris Pappas is in exactly that same kind of razor-thin race right now. Now, he’s up against his FEC pre-primary deadline that expires at MIDNIGHT tomorrow night. In a race this close, every day matters. Every dollar means more. And every deadline is a chance to show that Chris’s campaign has momentum. I know what it takes to win a race by the smallest of margins -- it takes all of us, doing everything we can, every chance we get. Especially when Republicans are counting on us to stay on the sidelines. Thank you, Maggie Hassan U.S. Senator, New Hampshire New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

body:

| | | | | |

| | Hello Peter,

Dr. Enoch’s campaign is moving across Ohio’s 8th Congressional District — **knocking doors, meeting voters, attending community events, organizing volunteers, and building the grassroots operation we need to compete.** Now we need your help with the next critical phase:

# WE NEED TO GET OUR MESSAGE IN FRONT OF MORE VOTERS.
With Election Day getting closer, we need to dramatically increase our visibility across the district. That means investing in **large campaign signs in high-traffic locations and digital advertising that reaches voters where they spend their time online.** And we need the resources to do it.
## CAN YOU HELP US FUND THE NEXT PHASE OF THIS CAMPAIGN?
Every contribution helps us communicate with more voters.A contribution can help us:
* Purchase **large-format campaign signs** for high-visibility locations throughout OH-8
* Expand our **digital advertising** to reach targeted voters across the district
* Produce and distribute campaign literature
* Support canvassing, phone banking and voter outreach
* Promote upcoming events and opportunities for voters to meet Dr. Enoch

**We cannot afford to be invisible.**
Our opponent has the advantages of incumbency, name recognition, and an established fundraising network. We are building something different: **a grassroots campaign powered by people who believe Ohio's 8th Congressional District deserves better representation.**

### [Will you invest $25, $50, $100, $250 — or whatever you can afford — to help us get our message out?](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=981cab1dee&e=c6e7dff14c)

**DONATE TODAY:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=36795c521c&e=c6e7dff14c)If you've already contributed, **thank you.** Your support is helping keep this campaign moving.
And if you can give again, this is an important time to do it.
* * *

[](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=8b0b96a942&e=c6e7dff14c)
# YARD SIGNS ARE IN!

We've heard from supporters across the district who want to show their support — and **our Vanessa Enoch for Congress yard signs have arrived!**
Putting a sign in your yard may seem like a small thing, but visibility matters.A yard sign tells your neighbors:
**There is a campaign happening. There is an alternative. There is a choice.**
### Request your FREE yard sign here:

[https://enochforcongress.com/product/free-yard-sign/](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=c4b1224366&e=c6e7dff14c)
After you request yours, encourage a neighbor, friend or family member in the district to request one too.
**Let's make support for this campaign visible throughout OH-8.**
* * *
[****](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=eb61bbea55&e=c6e7dff14c)
# COME MEET DR. ENOCH
We also have several opportunities coming up to meet Dr. Vanessa Enoch, talk about the issues, and get involved in the campaign.
## FROM CONVERSATION TO CONGRESS
### Meet & Greet Reception
**Tuesday, August 25, 2026**
**6:30 PM – 8:00 PM****Hummus & Pita**
7334 Tylers Corner Dr.
West Chester, OH 45069This is an opportunity for real conversation about the issues affecting our families and communities — and the solutions we need from Washington.**Real Conversations. Real Solutions. Real Impact.****RSVP:**
[https://campaignhq.app/rsvp/hummusandpita](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=c6aeee9857&e=c6e7dff14c)
* * *
[****](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=b464f1642d&e=c6e7dff14c)
## MEET THE CANDIDATE
### Major Minor Books and Such
**Thursday, August 27**
**7:00 PM – 8:30 PM**
_Doors open at 6:45 PM_**Major Minor Books and Such**
6718 Montgomery Rd.
Cincinnati, OH 45236
Come meet Dr. Enoch and hear about her priorities for Ohio's 8th Congressional District, including protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering healthcare and prescription drug costs, strengthening veterans' services, creating jobs, expanding affordable housing, investing in American manufacturing, and holding government accountable.
Bring your questions — and bring a friend. [RSVP here](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=8c87c4927b&e=c6e7dff14c).
* * *
[](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=2f8ed229f0&e=c6e7dff14c)
## CANVASS GREENHILLS WITH US!
### Canvass for Jonathan Bradner & Dr. Vanessa Enoch
**Sunday, August 30**
**2:00 PM – 5:00 PM****Drummond St. & Damon Rd.**
99 Drummond Street
Greenhills, Ohio
The Cincinnati Working Families Party Wolf Pack is organizing a [canvass covering **Greenhills A, B and C. RSVP on Mobilize here.**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=77ae4e498d&e=c6e7dff14c)
No canvassing experience is necessary. **Training will be provided.**
Bring a fully charged phone, comfortable walking shoes, and a friend.
* * *
# WE HAVE A LOT OF WORK TO DO — AND NOT A LOT OF TIME.
This campaign is growing.People are volunteering.People are requesting signs.People are attending events.People are knocking doors.And voters are beginning to hear our message.
**Now we need to scale.**
That requires resources.When you contribute to this campaign, you aren't simply making a donation. **You're helping us communicate with voters who may otherwise never hear about this race.**
You're helping us put up the signs.You're helping us run the ads.You're helping us print the literature.You're helping us knock the doors.You're helping us build the field operation.And ultimately, **you're helping give voters in Ohio's 8th Congressional District a real choice.**

### Please make a contribution today.

**DONATE:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=36d3e8662c&e=c6e7dff14c)

**VOLUNTEER:**
[ https://campaignhq.app](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=723812c585&e=c6e7dff14c)
[Whether you can give **$10, $25, $50, $100, $250 or more** , your contribution moves us closer to the resources we need to compete.](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=0cb7050300&e=c6e7dff14c)
**We can do this — but we have to do it together.** Thank you for believing in this campaign and in what we are working to build for Ohio's 8th Congressional District.
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Nominee for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District

I don't agree with Speaker Mike Johnson very often. But he's right about one thing. When he came to Southwest Washington last month to raise money for my opponent, he told the room that Washington's 3rd District will decide who controls the House. He's right. There are only a handful of true toss-up seats in the country, and this is one of them. That's why the Speaker of the House came all the way to Southwest Washington to raise money for my opponent.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137485662/640981167/724950626?refcode=260818-agree-mj-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZWRiYjZiMC03MTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wxxui9GyRSFIjoXyj424-KMrTwIS5OOg9uCaH6HdNs0=)

It's why Republican outside groups have already spent or reserved nearly $7 million in advertising against me here. And it's why national Republicans are prepared to spend even more before Election Day. They've done the math. They know how much this seat matters. So do I. I've won here twice by earning the support of people who don't always agree with me, but know I'll put Southwest Washington ahead of either political party. I don't take corporate PAC money. I don't answer to party leadership. And I'm not interested in becoming another reliable vote for whoever happens to be in charge in Washington, D.C. That's exactly the kind of representation national Republicans are spending millions to replace. Mike Johnson came here because Republicans believe winning this seat could keep them in control of the House. I think that's a pretty good reason for us to fight like hell to keep it. name: Tim Moore
subject: I joined Newsmax yesterday
disclaimer_text: paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
body:
Peter,

I've seen it too many times. A magistrate judge makes a reckless call, and a dangerous repeat offender walks right back out onto the streets — into your neighborhood, near your kids' school, back in the community they already victimized once.

That's not justice. That's a failure. And it's time somebody in Washington said so out loud.

Yesterday, I joined Newsmax to talk about my bill, the Judicial Accountability for Public Safety Act [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/081826_news_moore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=08.18.26_News_Moore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true] — legislation that finally puts real accountability measures in place for magistrate judges whose decisions put public safety at risk. No more hiding behind the bench when a bad call gets somebody hurt.

I've spent my career fighting for law enforcement and the folks who play by the rules. This bill is a continuation of that fight, and I wanted you to hear it straight from me.

Take a few minutes and watch the interview [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/081826_news_moore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=08.18.26_News_Moore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true] — I think you'll see exactly why this fight matters.

Social Security turned 91 the other day. My wife used to make fun of me for making every speech about Social Security. Is this a boring subject? Does anyone care about the budget anymore?
Once when I was campaigning, a veteran pressed his dog tag into my palm and told me never to break my promise to fight for Social Security. By his account, he had started paying into it when he was 12 years old. He never stopped working and was still employed as a church custodian when I met him. Now in his mid-70s, he said he couldn't retire.
I never found the budget to be boring after meeting people like him. He earned the dignity of a secure retirement, but our society isn't letting him have it. If we don't tackle the budget, he never will. The Social Security trustees now say that the program has only [6-8 years of solvency left](https://substack.com/redirect/68ca53b9-03b5-4306-99d7-48c933504f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and if Social Security were to go away, [22 million additional people](https://substack.com/redirect/59693935-d8fd-45bb-b7a0-a8efb4970045?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) would be plunged into poverty. Those are pretty high stakes.
How did we get here? And what can we do about it? Here is the state of play:
